description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for persistence integration tests related to reading 'Thing' objects in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends another test class, manages policy enforcers, and provides methods for creating, persisting, and deleting 'Thing' instances with different versions and configurations.

classes.name: AbstractReadPersistenceITBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration tests involving reading 'Thing' objects with customizable policy enforcement and version handling.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and sets up the default policy enforcer before each test.

methods.name: findForCriteria
methods.description: Finds all 'ThingId' instances matching the given criteria.

methods.name: isV1
methods.description: Checks if the current schema version is V1.

methods.name: persistThing
methods.description: Persist a 'Thing' object, delegating to version-specific methods.

methods.name: createThing
methods.description: Creates a 'Thing' with the specified ID.

methods.name: createThingV1
methods.description: Creates a version 1 'Thing' with default READ permission for known subjects.

methods.name: createThingV2
methods.description: Creates a version 2 'Thing' with a specified policy ID.

methods.name: persistThingV2
methods.description: Persists a version 2 'Thing' with a policy enforcer.

methods.name: createThings
methods.description: Creates a list of 'Thing' objects from a collection of IDs.

methods.name: deleteThing
methods.description: Deletes a 'Thing' given its object and policy revision.

methods.name: deleteThing
methods.description: Deletes a 'Thing' given its ID, revision, and optional policy ID.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version for the test; default is LATEST.

methods.name: getPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Returns the policy enforcer used for testing; default allows READ access to known subjects.

methods.name: createPolicy
methods.description: Creates a sample policy with predefined subjects and resource permissions.
